name: punch-munkey-host-portal-docker-build
description: Not the real monorepo root package.json (../../package.json) — a trimmed stand-in the Dockerfile installs from instead. The real root's `workspaces` list also includes punch-munkey-guest-app and punch-munkey-host-app (Expo/React Native apps with their own large, unrelated native-adjacent dependency trees) — yarn classic requires every explicitly-listed workspace path to exist and have a package.json, so building this image from the real root would mean installing those two apps' dependencies just to produce a static web bundle that never touches them. This lists only punch-munkey-host-portal and the one workspace dependency it actually has: @punch-munkey/ui-web.
